daily.today_energy: Mercury's whispering something real today, Virgo. Your mind is sharp but restless—lean into curiosity instead of overthinking. Trust the vibe shifts happening around you; they're pointing somewhere good.
daily.love: Someone's energy is shifting toward you, or maybe you're finally seeing someone differently. Either way, authenticity is your love language right now. No masks needed—just show up as you actually are.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is basically a superpower today. That project or idea you've been hesitant about? The timing feels right to move it forward. Your gut knows what your brain's still processing.
daily.health: Your nervous system's asking for gentleness. Whether that's a walk, tea, or just putting your phone down—honor that. Small acts of self-care compound into real energy shifts.

weekly.overview: Mercury's got your back this week, Virgo. You're entering a phase where your intuition is just as sharp as your logic—lean into that balance. Things are moving slower than you'd like, but that's actually giving you space to choose what matters.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is a week to show up differently—less planning, more presence. Single? Someone might slide into your orbit who appreciates your realness. Don't overthink the vibe; just feel it out.
weekly.career: Your ideas are landing harder than usual. This isn't the week to play small—share that project proposal or take on something that stretches you. Recognition isn't guaranteed, but your effort absolutely counts.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness, not hustle. Move in ways that feel good rather than punishing. Sleep matters more than you think right now. Hydrate and maybe pick up something grounding—tea, journaling, whatever centers you.
